about:
National Medical Solutions was founded in 2008 in Boise, Idaho. The company operates as a Medicare-accredited supplier of home medical equipment.

The company specializes in medical and osteoarthritis bracing, offering a range of home medical equipment. It handles insurance billing for customers, provides competitive pricing, and maintains exclusive product lines. Services include patient education, proper fitting, and ongoing support.

National Medical Solutions serves patients requiring orthotic and home medical equipment, particularly those covered by Medicare. Its customer base includes individuals seeking bracing solutions for osteoarthritis and other medical conditions, as well as healthcare providers looking for reliable equipment sourcing.

The company distinguishes itself through its Medicare accreditation, expertise in insurance billing, and commitment to patient education. Its exclusive product lines and focus on proper fitting and ongoing support aim to improve patient outcomes and simplify the procurement process.
